notes: The page was cut at 5000 elements, the collector's limit: what comes after them is not in the snapshot, so the checks that read the snapshot (Rampa's rules and judged criteria) did not run past that point. Checked only up to the cut: 1.1.1, 1.4.3, 1.4.4, 1.4.11, 2.4.2, 2.4.4, 2.4.6, 3.1.1, 4.1.2. axe-core read the whole page.

A layer lay over the viewport when the page was read (div, on top at 89% of the points sampled: a consent backdrop, a dialog): it was hidden while images, labels and contrast were captured, so the pixels measured are the page's own.
60 element(s) focusable by tabindex, past the limit, were not asked about their event listeners, so rampa/custom-control did not check them.

104 image(s) were left without a capture, so no judgment looked at them: 1 outside the page (an off-canvas menu); 2 cut off by the box that holds it; 1 blank in its capture; 100 over the limit of images captured per page. The snapshot says why for each (native.imageSkipped).
The model judged at most 50 candidates per criterion on this page (--max-candidates), those with a generic text first; it did not judge 5 of 55 for 2.4.4. The coverage lists them as not judged.

Not checked on a single page: 3.2.3 Consistent Navigation, 3.2.4 Consistent Identification and 3.2.6 Consistent Help compare the pages of a site, 2.4.5 Multiple Ways lists the ways to find them, and 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks needs them to tell the blocks that repeat from the content; crawl its address with --crawl or --sitemap.
